words.defn_en: to thicken, clot:

sentences.en: The blood began to ______ almost immediately around the wound.
sentences.zh: 血液幾乎立即開始在傷口周圍凝結。

sentences.en: Cold temperatures caused the sauce to ______ into a thick paste.
sentences.zh: 低溫使這道醬汁凝結成濃稠的糊狀。

words.defn_en: to have different opinions join together; fuse; converge

sentences.en: The various protest groups eventually ______d into a single movement.
sentences.zh: 這些不同的抗議團體最終融合成了一個單一的運動。

sentences.en: Their individual ideas began to ______ into a coherent business plan.
sentences.zh: 他們各自的想法開始融合成一份條理清晰的商業計畫。

words.defn_en: the process of coming together to form one mass or whole:
words.root_note: co- (together) + alescere (to grow up), from Latin

sentences.en: The merger represented the ______ of two once-rival companies.
sentences.zh: 這場合併代表了兩家昔日競爭對手的融合。

sentences.en: Scientists studied the ______ of tiny water droplets into larger raindrops.
sentences.zh: 科學家研究了微小水滴融合成較大雨滴的過程。

words.defn_en: coming together to form one mass or whole:
words.root_note: co- (together) + alescere (to grow up), from Latin

sentences.en: The two political movements proved ______ , eventually forming a single party.
sentences.zh: 這兩股政治運動證明具有融合性,最終合併成單一政黨。

sentences.en: Researchers observed ______ cell clusters forming under the microscope.
sentences.zh: 研究人員在顯微鏡下觀察到正在融合的細胞群。

words.defn_en: a temporary alliance formed for joint action, especially in politics:
words.root_note: co- (together) + alescere (to grow up), from Latin

sentences.en: Three smaller parties formed a ______ to challenge the ruling majority.
sentences.zh: 三個較小的政黨組成聯盟,挑戰執政的多數黨。

sentences.en: The environmental ______ brought together groups that rarely agreed on anything else.
sentences.zh: 這個環保聯盟,聚集了平時鮮少在其他議題上達成共識的團體。

words.defn_en: to force:put a person in duress

sentences.en: The manager tried to ______ his employees into working overtime without pay.
sentences.zh: 經理試圖脅迫員工在沒有加班費的情況下加班。

sentences.en: No one should be ______ into signing a contract against their will.
sentences.zh: 任何人都不應該被強迫違背自己的意願簽署合約。

words.defn_en: forceful, convincing, persuasive:

sentences.en: The lawyer presented a ______ argument that convinced the jury.
sentences.zh: 這位律師提出了一個令人信服的論點,說服了陪審團。

sentences.en: Her essay offered a ______ explanation for the company's decline.
sentences.zh: 她的文章對這家公司的衰落提出了令人信服的解釋。

words.defn_en: related by descent from the same ancestor or origin, especially of words:

sentences.en: "Night" in English and "Nacht" in German are ______ words.
sentences.zh: 英文的 night 與德文的 Nacht 是同源詞。

sentences.en: Linguists trace ______ terms across Indo-European languages to reconstruct their common ancestor.
sentences.zh: 語言學家透過追溯印歐語系中的同源詞,重建它們共同的祖語。

words.defn_en: aware:

sentences.en: Drivers must remain ______ of pedestrians when turning at intersections.
sentences.zh: 駕駛在路口轉彎時必須隨時意識到行人的存在。

sentences.en: She was fully ______ of the risks before starting her own business.
sentences.zh: 在創業之前,她完全意識到其中的風險。

words.defn_en: logically consistent, intelligible:

sentences.en: Her essay presented a ______ argument from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 她的文章從頭到尾都呈現出條理清晰的論點。

sentences.en: After the accident, he was too dazed to give a ______ account of events.
sentences.zh: 事故發生後,他頭暈目眩,無法清楚連貫地描述事情經過。

words.defn_en: a surprising and unexpected event:

sentences.en: Meeting my neighbor at the airport was a ______.
sentences.zh: 在機場遇見我的鄰居真是一場巧合。

sentences.en: It was no mere ______ that both companies launched similar products the same week.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司在同一週推出類似的產品,絕非單純的巧合。

words.defn_en: occurring or operating at the same time:

sentences.en: The rise in sales was ______ with the launch of the new ad campaign.
sentences.zh: 銷售量的上升與新廣告宣傳活動的推出恰好同時發生。

sentences.en: Her promotion was merely ______ with the company's restructuring, not caused by it.
sentences.zh: 她的升遷只是恰巧與公司重組同時發生,並非因此而起。

words.defn_en: working together on a task:

sentences.en: The scientists' ______ led to a breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 科學家們的合作促成了一項突破。

sentences.en: The two studios announced a new ______ on an upcoming film.
sentences.zh: 這兩家製片公司宣布將在一部即將推出的電影上展開合作。

words.defn_en: secondary:

sentences.en: The bank required his car as ______ for the loan.
sentences.zh: 銀行要求他以汽車作為這筆貸款的擔保品。

sentences.en: The bombing caused significant ______ damage to nearby buildings.
sentences.zh: 這次轟炸對附近的建築物造成了嚴重的附帶損害。

words.defn_en: to gather together; to accumulate:

sentences.en: Volunteers spent the morning collecting litter along the riverbank.
sentences.zh: 志工們花了一整個早上,沿著河岸撿拾垃圾。

sentences.en: She began to ______ vintage postcards after inheriting her grandmother's collection.
sentences.zh: 她繼承了祖母的收藏後,便開始收集古董明信片。

words.defn_en: a group of objects gathered together, especially as a hobby or study:

sentences.en: His stamp ______ includes items from over sixty countries.
sentences.zh: 他的郵票收藏包含來自六十多個國家的藏品。

sentences.en: The museum's new ______ focuses on textiles from Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 這座博物館的新收藏聚焦於東南亞的紡織品。

words.defn_en: to crash violently together:

sentences.en: The two cars ______d at the intersection during rush hour.
sentences.zh: 這兩輛車在尖峰時段的十字路口相撞。

sentences.en: Her ambitious plans began to ______ with her partner's more cautious approach.
sentences.zh: 她雄心勃勃的計畫,開始與夥伴較為謹慎的做法產生衝突。

words.defn_en: an instance of crashing violently together:

sentences.en: The head-on ______ closed the highway for several hours.
sentences.zh: 這起正面碰撞事故讓高速公路封閉了好幾個小時。

sentences.en: Their differing visions for the company led to a major ______ during the board meeting.
sentences.zh: 他們對公司願景的不同看法,在董事會上引發了重大衝突。

words.defn_en: pertaining to common everyday speech; conversational

sentences.en: The novel's ______ dialogue made the characters feel real.
sentences.zh: 這部小說口語化的對話讓角色顯得真實生動。

sentences.en: "Gonna" is a ______ contraction of "going to."
sentences.zh: 「gonna」是「going to」的口語化縮寫。

words.defn_en: to cooperate secretly, especially for an illegal or dishonest purpose:

sentences.en: Prosecutors accused the two executives of conspiring to ______ on pricing.
sentences.zh: 檢方指控這兩名高階主管密謀勾結操縱價格。

sentences.en: Investigators found no evidence that the companies had ______d to fix the market.
sentences.zh: 調查人員未發現任何證據顯示這些公司曾共謀操縱市場。

words.defn_en: secret agreement, conspiracy:

sentences.en: Investigators suspected ______ between the two rival companies to fix prices.
sentences.zh: 調查人員懷疑這兩家對手公司勾結操縱價格。

sentences.en: The scandal revealed years of ______ between officials and contractors.
sentences.zh: 這起醜聞揭露了官員與承包商多年來的勾結。

words.defn_en: beginning; starting:

sentences.en: The new policy takes effect ______ next Monday.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策將自下週一開始生效。

sentences.en: Employees ______ their first week will attend a full day of orientation.
sentences.zh: 即將展開第一週工作的員工,將參加為期一整天的新人訓練。

words.defn_en: to praise formally or officially; to recommend:

sentences.en: The principal ______ed the students for their perfect attendance record.
sentences.zh: 校長表揚了這些出席率完美的學生。

sentences.en: I can ______ this restaurant without hesitation to anyone visiting the city.
sentences.zh: 我毫不猶豫地推薦這家餐廳給任何造訪這座城市的人。

words.defn_en: a notice of approval or recognition:

sentences.en: The firefighter received a ______ for his bravery during the rescue.
sentences.zh: 這名消防員因救援時的英勇表現而獲得嘉獎。

sentences.en: Her outstanding performance earned her a formal ______ from the mayor.
sentences.zh: 她傑出的表現讓她獲得市長的正式表揚。

words.defn_en: corresponding in size or amount:

sentences.en: Her salary should be ______ with her years of experience.
sentences.zh: 她的薪水應該與她多年的經驗相稱。

sentences.en: The punishment must be ______ with the severity of the crime.
sentences.zh: 這項懲罰必須與犯罪的嚴重程度相稱。

words.defn_en: an explanatory or critical discussion of a text or event:

sentences.en: The documentary features expert ______ from leading historians.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片收錄了頂尖歷史學家的專業解說。

sentences.en: Her blog offers sharp ______ on current political events.
sentences.zh: 她的部落格對時事政治提供了犀利的評論。

words.defn_en: the process of making something a business:

sentences.en: The ______ of the product increased sales.
sentences.zh: 這項產品的商業化提升了銷售量。

sentences.en: Some critics worry about the ______ of traditional festivals.
sentences.zh: 有些評論者擔心傳統節慶正逐漸商業化。

words.defn_en: to manage or exploit something for financial gain; to turn into a commercial product or activity:

sentences.en: The company plans to ______ its new technology by next year.
sentences.zh: 這家公司計畫在明年將這項新技術商業化。

sentences.en: Some fans felt the beloved cartoon had been overly ______.
sentences.zh: 一些粉絲覺得這部深受喜愛的卡通已經被過度商業化了。

words.defn_en: to mix or blend together:

sentences.en: The two rivers ______ just south of the old mill.
sentences.zh: 這兩條河流在舊磨坊南邊匯流混合。

sentences.en: Her music ______s traditional folk melodies with modern electronic beats.
sentences.zh: 她的音樂融合了傳統民謠旋律與現代電子節拍。

words.defn_en: to reduce to small particles or fragments:

sentences.en: The machine can ______ ore into a fine powder within seconds.
sentences.zh: 這台機器能在幾秒內將礦石粉碎成細粉。

sentences.en: The pharmacist had to ______ the tablet for the patient who couldn't swallow pills.
sentences.zh: 藥師必須把藥錠搗碎,以便無法吞嚥藥丸的病人服用。

words.defn_en: feel or express sympathy or compassion:

sentences.en: Her friends gathered to ______ with her after the difficult breakup.
sentences.zh: 在這次痛苦的分手後,她的朋友們聚在一起安慰她。

sentences.en: He called to ______ with his coworker over the loss of the contract.
sentences.zh: 他打電話向同事表達對失去這份合約的慰問。

words.defn_en: dedicated to a cause or task:

sentences.en: Ava is ______ to her studies and always wants top grades.
sentences.zh: 艾娃全心投入於學業,總是希望拿到最高的成績。

sentences.en: He remains fully ______ to finishing the marathon despite his injury.
sentences.zh: 儘管受了傷,他仍然全心堅持要完成這場馬拉松。

words.defn_en: large, spacious:

sentences.en: The new house has a ______ kitchen perfect for entertaining.
sentences.zh: 這棟新房子擁有一個寬敞的廚房,非常適合宴客。

sentences.en: Their ______ living room could easily fit fifty guests.
sentences.zh: 他們寬敞的客廳輕鬆就能容納五十位賓客。

words.defn_en: friendly and sociable; pleasant to be with:

sentences.en: Their ______ silence during the long drive was more comfortable than conversation.
sentences.zh: 他們在漫長車程中友好而自在的沉默,比交談更讓人感到自在。

sentences.en: The old dog was ______ and gentle with every visitor.
sentences.zh: 這隻老狗對每位訪客都溫和又易相處。

words.defn_en: sympathetic feeling, kindness:

sentences.en: The nurse treated every patient with great ______.
sentences.zh: 這位護士以極大的憐憫心對待每一位病人。

sentences.en: She felt a wave of ______ for the stray dog shivering in the rain.
sentences.zh: 看到那隻在雨中發抖的流浪狗,她心中湧起一股同情。

words.defn_en: feeling or showing sympathy and concern for others:

sentences.en: The nurse's ______ care comforted patients during their most difficult moments.
sentences.zh: 護理師富有同情心的照顧,在病人最艱難的時刻給予他們安慰。

sentences.en: He responded to the criticism with a surprisingly ______ letter rather than anger.
sentences.zh: 面對批評,他以一封出乎意料充滿同情心的信回應,而非憤怒。

words.defn_en: the state of being able to exist or work together harmoniously:
words.root_note: com- (together) + pati (to suffer, endure), from Latin

sentences.en: The couple's counselor focused on improving their emotional ______.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻的諮商師,著重於改善他們情感上的協調性。

sentences.en: Before buying the software, check its ______ with your current operating system.
sentences.zh: 在購買這套軟體前,請確認它與你目前作業系統的相容性。

words.defn_en: harmonious, well-matched:

sentences.en: The new software is ______ with most older computers.
sentences.zh: 這款新軟體與大多數舊型電腦相容。

sentences.en: Their personalities turned out to be surprisingly ______.
sentences.zh: 他們的個性出乎意料地十分契合。

words.defn_en: captivating or persuasive:
words.defn_zh: 引人入勝的/有說服力的

sentences.en: The debater gave a ______ argument.
sentences.zh: 這位辯論者提出了一個極具說服力的論點。

sentences.en: The documentary offers a ______ look into the lives of deep-sea creatures.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片對深海生物的生活提供了引人入勝的視角。

words.defn_en: giving a lot of information in a concise, well-organized way:

sentences.en: Her ______ summary covered the entire semester's material in just four pages.
sentences.zh: 她簡明扼要的摘要,只用四頁就涵蓋了整個學期的內容。

sentences.en: The professor recommended a ______ history text rather than the full multivolume set.
sentences.zh: 教授推薦一本簡明的歷史教材,而非整套多冊的巨著。

words.defn_en: a concise collection of information on a particular subject:

sentences.en: The encyclopedia serves as a ______ of world knowledge in a single set of volumes.
sentences.zh: 這套百科全書是一套彙集世界知識的概要巨著。

sentences.en: He compiled a ______ of local folklore before the last elders passed away.
sentences.zh: 他在最後幾位長者過世前,彙編了一本當地民間傳說的合集。

words.defn_en: payment given in return for a loss, suffering, or service:

sentences.en: The airline offered ______ for the canceled flight.
sentences.zh: 航空公司對這班取消的航班提供了補償。

sentences.en: Her ______ package included stock options in addition to her salary.
sentences.zh: 她的薪酬方案除了薪水之外,還包括了股票選擇權。

words.defn_en: making up for a loss:

sentences.en: The airline offered ______ vouchers to passengers whose flights were canceled.
sentences.zh: 航空公司向班機被取消的乘客提供補償性的抵用券。

sentences.en: The court awarded ______ damages for the injuries he suffered.
sentences.zh: 法院判給他因傷所受損失的補償金。

words.defn_en: having the necessary ability or skill:

sentences.en: Noah has worked at this job for a long time and is a ______ engineer.
sentences.zh: 諾亞在這份工作上已經做了很久,是一位稱職能幹的工程師。

sentences.en: The new hire proved to be more than ______ during her first week.
sentences.zh: 這位新進員工在第一週就證明了自己相當能幹。

words.defn_en: self-satisfied ignorance of danger:

sentences.en: Years of success had led to a dangerous sense of ______ within the company.
sentences.zh: 多年的成功讓這家公司產生了一種危險的自滿心態。

sentences.en: The coach warned his team against ______ after their early lead.
sentences.zh: 教練警告球隊不要因為早早取得領先而自滿。

words.defn_en: self-satisfied:

sentences.en: The team grew ______ after their early lead and lost focus.
sentences.zh: 這支隊伍在早早取得領先後變得自滿,失去了專注力。

sentences.en: Success should never make you ______ about future challenges.
sentences.zh: 成功絕不該讓你對未來的挑戰感到自滿。

words.defn_en: to complete, make perfect:

sentences.en: The soft music helped ______ the quiet, elegant atmosphere of the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 輕柔的音樂讓這間餐廳寧靜優雅的氛圍更加相得益彰。

sentences.en: Her calm personality ______s his more energetic nature perfectly.
sentences.zh: 她沉穩的個性與他較為活潑的性格相輔相成。

words.defn_en: serving to complete another

sentences.en: Their skills are ______; she handles design while he manages finances.
sentences.zh: 他們的技能互補;她負責設計,而他負責財務管理。

sentences.en: The wine was chosen for its ______ flavor to the seafood dish.
sentences.zh: 這款葡萄酒的挑選是因為它與海鮮料理的風味相得益彰。

words.defn_en: the state of being intricate or complicated:

sentences.en: The ______ of the 1,000 piece puzzle made it challenging.
sentences.zh: 這幅一千片拼圖的複雜程度讓它頗具挑戰性。

sentences.en: The lawyer explained the legal ______ of the case in simple terms.
sentences.zh: 這位律師用簡單的說法解釋了這個案件的法律複雜性。

words.defn_en: yielding, submissive

sentences.en: The new employee was eager to be ______ with every company rule.
sentences.zh: 這位新員工急於順從公司的每一項規定。

sentences.en: The dog was surprisingly ______ during its first visit to the vet.
sentences.zh: 這隻狗在第一次看獸醫時出乎意料地十分順從。
